Glasstual for macOS

IRC, made for the Mac.

A native IRC client for macOS 26 with a system sidebar, Liquid Glass and modern IRCv3.

Download Latest Release macOS 26 or later, Apple silicon View Source ↗

Signed and notarized. Free and open source.

Features

Everything IRC, the way a Mac app should do it.

  • History and Search

    On servers that keep history, Glasstual loads recent messages when you join, fills gaps after a reconnect and loads earlier messages as you scroll up. Search every stored conversation with Shift-Command-F, filter by server, conversation, nickname or date, and jump to the message in context.

  • Sign In Your Way

    SASL sign-in with a password (PLAIN), a password proof (SCRAM-SHA-256 or SCRAM-SHA-512), a client certificate (EXTERNAL), an ECDSA signing key (ECDSA-NIST256P-CHALLENGE) or an OAuth token (OAUTHBEARER). Passwords, keys and tokens are stored in the macOS Keychain.

  • Account Registration

    On networks that support it, register an account from the app and enter the verification code the network emails you. Glasstual then signs in with SASL.

  • IRC over WebSocket

    Connect to networks that accept IRC over WebSocket, encrypted with TLS (wss://) or not (ws://), with the gateway path set per server.

  • Proxies and Tor

    Give each server its own SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy, or connect through Tor with Tor Browser running. Images never go around a server’s proxy: with a SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy, each image loads only when you click it.

  • Secure DCC and XDCC

    Send files and open direct chats, optionally encrypted with TLS. The first time you connect securely with someone you check their certificate fingerprint and choose whether to trust it, and Glasstual warns you if it later changes. Request packs from XDCC bots and see your place in the queue.

  • Profiles

    On servers that support profile metadata, set a display name, a picture and a color, and see the ones other people have set.

  • Dialogs or In-Conversation Prompts

    Choose whether questions open as dialogs or appear in the conversation, where you answer with a click or a command such as /yes, /no or /answer.

  • Modern IRCv3

    Multiline messages, message deletion, channel renames, replies, reactions, typing notifications and read markers, negotiated with each server.

  • Bouncers

    Connect to a soju bouncer once and see each of its networks nested under one account. ZNC playback options are built in.

  • Shortcuts and Spotlight

    Send a message, join a channel, connect, disconnect or open a conversation from Shortcuts. Servers and channels can appear in Spotlight, and direct conversations if you opt in. Only names are indexed, on your Mac, and you can turn it off.

  • Focus Filters and Idle Away

    Let a Focus filter mute notifications, set you away, or both, and set yourself away automatically when your Mac is idle.

  • Transcript Themes

    The default theme follows your Mac’s appearance, accent color and Increase Contrast setting. Or choose a preset (Classic, GitHub, Tokyo Night, One Dark, Dracula, Nord or Solarized), or set each color yourself.

  • Server Properties and People

    Each server’s properties open in a window of their own, so you can keep them open while you chat. The People window lists who you ignore and who you want to hear about when they come online.

  • Logs and Channel Lists

    Browse saved transcript logs without leaving the app, and view or edit a channel’s bans, ban exceptions, invite exceptions and quiets.

  • Built-In Help

    Glasstual Help, in the Help menu, covers setup, sign-in, secure connections, file transfers, commands, keyboard shortcuts and troubleshooting.

  • Native macOS 26 Interface

    A system sidebar, a Liquid Glass input field, and light and dark appearances that follow your Mac. Pick a color and an icon for each server; a network that advertises its own icon shows it in the sidebar.

  • Made for Daily Use

    Multiple servers, favorites, unread filters, mentions, notifications, slash-command suggestions, message rules and user scripts.

Transcript Styles

Lines or Bubbles.

Choose the compact IRC layout or a conversation view with bubbles. Both work with every transcript theme, in light and dark.
